title: Genome-wide identification, characterization and expression profiling of purple acid phosphatases under variable phosphorus regimes in lentil (Lens culinaris Medik.).
authors: Chakraborty, Ankita; Das, Arpita; Banerjee, Joydeep
one_liner_zh: 该文对扁豆紫色酸性磷酸酶基因家族进行全基因组鉴定与表达分析，虽含蛋白-配体对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Purple acid phosphatases, an important sub-class of metallo-phosphoesterase, play a key role in the uptake and homeostasis of phosphorus in plants, especially under phosphorus limited conditions. Phosphorus deficiency in legumes leads to an impaired growth, poor nodulation and a significant decline in yield potential. RESULTS: In this study, 22 putative purple acid phosphatase genes in Lens culinaris (LcPAPs) were identified, distributed across seven chromosomes with chromosome 4 harbouring the highest number. In-silico analysis revealed their gene structures, physico-chemical properties, structures of the PAP proteins, and predicted sub-cellular localization. Most of the LcPAPs were found to possess a signal peptide suggesting their involvement in the secretory pathway, whereas LcPAP3 lacking any signal peptide was uniquely localized in the nucleus. Considering molecular weights, the LcPAPs clustered into three groups and were classified in five out of six clades in a phylogenetic tree constructed with PAPs from soyabean, rice and Arabidopsis. Synteny analysis of LcPAPs revealed the highest conservation with soyabean followed by Arabidopsis and least with rice, consistent with the lineage divergence of dicots and monocots that occurred million years ago. Promoter analysis of the LcPAPs revealed the presence of multiple cis elements associated with stress responsive transcription factors, including PHR1, a key regulator of phosphorus starvation response. Docking studies of the protein with ligands like para-nitrophenyl phosphate (pNPP) and phytic acid revealed the involvement of the conserved motifs and different covalent bonds in protein-ligand interaction. Gene expression analysis under differential phosphorus regimes revealed root specific upregulation of LcPAP20, while constitutive upregulation in both root and shoot tissues of LcPAP4 annotated with oxidoreductase and phosphatase enzyme activity under low as well as high phosphorus conditions as compared to control. In contrast, LcPAP9 predicted to possess dual phosphatase-phytase activity was highly upregulated in the shoots under phosphorus deficient condition as compared to phosphorus sufficiency. CONCLUSIONS: These findings provide foundational insights into the functional diversification of LcPAPs on an intricate molecular level, and might pave the way of identifying key regulatory genes of lentil involved in phosphorus homeostasis. Further in-depth bioinformatics study on LcPAPs with their two potential interactors has unravelled their potential role and binding efficacies.
abstract_zh: 背景：紫色酸性磷酸酶是金属磷酸酯酶的一个重要亚类，在植物对磷的吸收和稳态维持中发挥关键作用，尤其是在磷限制条件下。豆科植物缺磷会导致生长受损、结瘤不良以及产量潜力显著下降。结果：本研究在兵豆（Lens culinaris）中鉴定出22个推定紫色酸性磷酸酶基因（LcPAPs），分布于七条染色体上，其中4号染色体上的数量最多。通过计算机模拟分析揭示了它们的基因结构、理化性质、PAP蛋白结构以及预测的亚细胞定位。大多数LcPAPs被发现具有信号肽，提示其参与分泌途径，而缺乏信号肽的LcPAP3则独特地定位于细胞核。根据分子量，LcPAPs被分为三组，并在与大豆、水稻和拟南芥PAPs构建的系统发育树中归类于六个进化枝中的五个。LcPAPs的共线性分析显示其与大豆的保守性最高，其次是拟南芥，与水稻的保守性最低，这与数百万年前双子叶植物和单子叶植物的谱系分化一致。LcPAPs的启动子分析揭示了多个与胁迫响应转录因子相关的顺式元件，包括PHR1，这是磷饥饿响应的关键调控因子。蛋白质与配体（如对硝基苯磷酸（pNPP）和植酸）的对接研究揭示了保守基序和不同共价键在蛋白质-配体相互作用中的参与。在不同磷水平下的基因表达分析显示，LcPAP20在根部特异性上调，而LcPAP4在低磷和高磷条件下相较于对照在根和茎组织中均组成性上调，该基因被注释具有氧化还原酶和磷酸酶酶活性。相比之下，预测具有双重磷酸酶-植酸酶活性的LcPAP9在磷缺乏条件下相较于磷充足条件下在茎中高度上调。结论：这些发现为LcPAPs在复杂分子水平上的功能分化提供了基础性见解，并可能为鉴定兵豆中参与磷稳态的关键调控基因铺平道路。对LcPAPs及其两个潜在互作因子的进一步深入生物信息学研究揭示了它们的潜在作用和结合效率。
